Fixed a unit-notation inconsistency in PulseJournal's Japanese output—the hero tone was occasionally expanding abbreviated units like "bpm" into English words. Added an explicit instruction to preserve units as-is.
Added i18n-lite, a dependency-free EN/JA language module for vendoring across CHUNK tools. Includes localStorage persistence, DOM declarative bindings, and full test coverage.

Improved Japanese prompts for hero/poetic tones to prevent Chinese character drift and unwanted explanatory text. Added language enforcement, few-shot examples with proper numeral formatting, and constraints on output structure.
Compressed MIX feed saves to Ogg/Opus (96kbps) via vendored libopus WASM encoder, reducing ~8.5MB WAV files to ~569KB while maintaining offline capability and fallback support for older browsers.
Improved audio recording to prefer WebM/Opus codec with graceful fallbacks, tracking mimeType per post. Mixed-format playback now tested across solo, loop, and layered scenarios.
